manifest.title: Baseball Pitching Analyzer
manifest.author: bstrana
manifest.description: Real-time baseball pitching and swing mechanics analysis, powered by TensorFlow.js pose detection running entirely in the browser. Track pitching and hitting mechanics live from your webcam — all processing happens client-side in the browser; no server-side processing or account is required.
manifest.tagline: Real-time baseball pitching & swing mechanics analysis
manifest.changelog: Initial Cloudron packaging release.
manifest.postInstallMessage: The app is a static, client-side tool - no database or account setup is required. Open the app URL and grant camera access when your browser prompts for it (pose tracking runs locally in your browser). If the camera permission is denied, enable it in the browser site settings.

manifest.changelog: Fixed Pitch Tracker's on-canvas stats not showing up in recordings, and camera zoom not being reflected in recorded video - both were screen-only visual effects invisible to the recorder and are now baked into the actual captured frames. Bumped the default live-camera resolution request for higher-quality recordings. Enlarged the on-canvas prev/next-frame buttons for easier tapping on a phone. Added a pulsing "4 BALLS - WALK" alert once four pitches in a row come back as balls.
manifest.postInstallMessage: This app requires Keycloak sign-in. Create a client for this app in your Keycloak realm, then edit /app/data/config.env (KEYCLOAK_URL, KEYCLOAK_REALM, KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID) and restart the app from the Cloudron dashboard. Until then, the app shows a 'sign-in not configured' message. Player rosters and saved sessions are stored in a bundled PocketBase backend, scoped per coach via the same Keycloak realm - optionally set PB_ADMIN_EMAIL and PB_ADMIN_PASSWORD in the same config.env to reach its admin dashboard at this app's URL + /pb/_/. To let a coaching staff share a roster, set a matching "team" attribute on each coach in Keycloak and add a User Attribute protocol mapper exposing it as a "team" claim.
